title: Neural Rendering (DLSS 5)
description: s6-dlss (round 1), s6-reprojection-cloud-3 (run 78, register G-35; the owner, 2026-10-04: "a joke feature, I mean really add it in but we arnt serious about it"): the Experimental tab's Neural Rendering (DLSS 5) section, About and Controls. Drawing only: nothing is sent. The host's side is C# (TK.Modular.Draw.NeuralRendering).
